from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single financial record extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company identified in the document")
    fiscal_period: str | None = Field(description="Time period the financial report covers")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the specific cash flow line item")
    metric_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash flow line item")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[FinancialRecord]
